mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT B.EXM_CTG_NM AS exmCtgNm, C.SPCM_NM AS spcmNm, A.ITEM_CB_VRFC_IPTN_CNTE AS itemCbVrfcIptnCnte FROM ODS.S_MSELMAID A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MSELMCTC B ON A.MED_EXM_CTG_CD = B.EXM_CTG_CD INNER JOIN ODS.S_MSELMCCC C ON A.TH1_SPCM_CD = C.SPCM_CD WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.SPCM_NO = #{spcmNo} AND A.MED_EXM_CTG_CD = #{medExmCtgCd}

SELECT B.EITM_ABBR AS eitmAbbr, A.EXRS_FSRC_DCST_LDAT AS exrsFsrcDcstLdat, D.RFVL_LWLM_CNTE || ' ~ ' || D.RFVL_HGLM_CNTE || ' ' || A.EXRS_UNIT AS refCnte FROM ODS.S_MSELMAID A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MSELMEBM B ON A.EXM_CD = B.EXM_CD INNER JOIN ODS.S_PCTPCPAM C ON A.PT_NO = C.PT_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MSELMRRD D ON A.EXM_CD = D.EXM_CD AND A.ACPT_DTM <= D.AVL_END_DT AND C.SEX_TP_CD = D.SEX_TP_CD AND D.RFVL_TP_CD = 'R' AND D.RFVL_AGE_CTG_CD = 'Y' AND DATEDIFF('YEAR', C.PT_BRDY_DT, A.ACPT_DTM) BETWEEN D.LWLM_RANG_AGE AND D.HGLM_RANG_AGE WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.SPCM_NO = #{spcmNo} AND A.MED_EXM_CTG_CD = #{medExmCtgCd} ORDER BY B.SCRN_SORT_SEQ
